title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Notice-Lead Reduction
content:
The notice-lead reduction of the early termination fee of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement counts the calendar days from today to the termination effective date.

| Calendar days from today to the termination effective date | Reduction of the early termination fee |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | 10.0 percent off |
| 75 to 119 | 5.0 percent off |
| fewer than 75 | nothing |

**Hypothetical cases, today 2025-03-03.** A termination effective date of 2025-07-01 is 120 days away: 10.0 percent off. 2025-06-30 is 119 days away: 5.0 percent off. 2025-05-17 is 75 days away: 5.0 percent off. 2025-05-16 is 74 days away: nothing.
